hotels.title: Stylish Mackay Stay in the Heart of the Marina Village
hotels.description: Discover Mackay’s marina-side charm from this polished waterfront retreat at Mackay Harbour, moments from the golden curve of Harbour Beach and the departure point for cruises to the Great Barrier Reef. The Bluewater Trail and nearby Mackay Regional Botanic Gardens offer a gentler look at the region’s tropical landscape. Onsite, guests can dine on modern Australian fare at the marina-facing restaurant and cool off in the outdoor pool overlooking the water. A short drive away, The Dispensary serves refined share plates in the city centre, while Cape Hillsborough rewards early risers with wallabies gathering along the shoreline
